checks.name: Failed cold initialization reconnects in the same process after the database starts
The same warm process survives idle connection loss and database restart
A real TCP loss during an awaiting financial callback returns a controlled error, rolls back, and recovers in the same process
A genuinely committed transaction with a lost reply returns JSON 503 without exiting; the same warm process serves requests and same-key retry credits only once

limits: Only isolated loopback PostgreSQL and a local wire proxy were used; no user data or cloud accounts.
